This is a high-level administrative position that is responsible for providing leadership and management of staff personnel activities in a highly complex healthcare and public health environment, on diverse issues, many confidential in nature. The position reports directly to the Executive Assistant Dean and is responsible for human resource matters and ensuring oversight and compliance with personnel activities within the school. This position is expected to exercise strategic initiative and exceptional judgement to identify potential issues of concern and recommend solutions to achieve desired outcomes and to maximize organizational excellence. The position interacts closely with hospital leadership, associate deans, chairs, program directors, unit managers and supervisors providing policy-driven oversight and support related to staff personnel. This position keeps abreast of changing state and federally mandated laws/policies and healthcare and public health related regulations that govern the employment of the WSVM workforce. The incumbent contributes to accomplishment of the school’s strategic plan and objectives through identification of operational and workforce problems and mobilizes internal HR partners to solve. The positions responsibilities cover several of the following: recruitment, compensation, employee relations, labor relations, payroll, benefits, shift differential management, training and development, and visa procurement.
25% - Strategic Partnership, Planning, Implementation and Change Management
Familiarity with staff personnel, collective bargaining, and student employment regulations in a clinical, public health, and academic environment.

Leadership and team building skills demonstrated through past performance to recruit, train, evaluate, motivate, resolve problems/conflicts, conduct performance management, and build effective service-oriented, team environment.
